meta.title: Lazy Senior Dev Mode
meta.description: Persistent lazy senior developer mode with a seven-rung ladder (YAGNI down to the smallest implementation), six native skills, and zero tool registration.

A full DSH port of DietrichGebert/ponytail: the always-on lazy senior developer mode and its seven-rung ladder (YAGNI down to the minimum implementation), with six native Chinese skills (core, review, audit, debt, gain, help) and zero tool registrations.
